backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Quantumoney backend, defining player profiles, AR spot claims, planted coins, map markers, chat, and Stripe/access-control integrations with daily limit resets and distance calculations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing completed features such as Footer cleanup, Caffeine branding removal, and Profile/Wallet page merge, with associated file paths, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short descriptions summarizing each file's role and key implementation details.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Quantumoney app with Portuguese locale, SEO/OG metadata, Leaflet CSS CDN link, and a root div for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and LanguageProvider, and uses Layout as the root route component.
frontend/src/components/Container.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper component that centers content with configurable max-width sizes (sm/md/lg/xl/full) and responsive horizontal padding.
frontend/src/components/CookieConsentBan: Fixed bottom cookie consent banner that appears after a 1-second delay if consent hasn't been given, with Accept and Learn More buttons linking to the Privacy Policy.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a site footer with social sharing links (WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Instagram) using the current page URL and a copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/gold-paper/GoldP: Interactive visualization showing a global QMY token distribution network with clickable hotspot cards and a regional breakdown, driven by gold paper simulation data.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header with dropdown menus, mobile hamburger menu, and Internet Identity login/logout functionality using TanStack Router links.
frontend/src/components/InstitutionalExp: Wraps children in a styled section with a bilingual (PT/EN) disclaimer banner clarifying that the content is conceptual and non-operational, compliant with MiCA and GDPR.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that composes the Header, Footer, CookieConsentBanner, a lazy-loaded quantum background scene, and an Outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading states and a truncated principal ID when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/PageShell.tsx: Simple wrapper component that adds full viewport height and top padding to page content.
frontend/src/components/presale/PresaleL: Displays an interactive explorer for presale phases, allowing users to select a phase and view its allocation, price per token, bonus, and minimum purchase details.
frontend/src/components/presale/PresaleU: Renders a token unlock schedule visualization showing monthly unlock amounts and cumulative progress bars over a configurable vesting period.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARCoinBa: Displays a user's QTM coin balance broken down into available, locked, and bonus coins with a total summary and descriptive notes.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARMonste: Shows a player's captured AR monsters in a grid with icons, capture dates, and energy boosts, or an empty state prompt if none are captured.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARPlayer: Displays player XP and level statistics with a progress bar showing advancement toward the next level.
frontend/src/components/profile/Canister: Lists the official Internet Computer canisters for the Quantumoney platform (Carteira A), showing each canister's name, function, and ID.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileG: A simple wrapper card component with a glass/blur aesthetic and yellow border for consistent profile section styling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileH: Renders a fixed HUD overlay in the top-right corner displaying key player profile stats such as nickname, energy, XP, level, and token balances.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileP: Renders a 3-column grid of placeholder cards for Captured Monsters, Recent Activity, and Quick Actions, each marked as 'Coming soon'.
frontend/src/components/profile/Technica: Displays a technical validation panel showing the authenticated user's Principal ID, a list of Carteira A canister IDs with labels, and a timestamp of the last verification.
frontend/src/components/profile/useProfi: Custom hook that derives authentication and registration state (isAuthenticated, isRegistered, showProfileSetup) from identity and profile loading data.
frontend/src/components/quantum/QuantumU: Renders an animated Three.js/React Three Fiber 3D scene with gold/violet quantum particles, a pulsing torus ring, and a starfield background as a fixed full-screen canvas.
frontend/src/components/ReadOnlyBanner.t: Displays a styled banner indicating that the current dashboard is read-only and transfers/swaps are disabled.
frontend/src/components/SectionNavigator: Full-screen overlay navigation grid listing all major app sections with availability badges, closing on link click.
frontend/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx: Renders a styled badge indicating one of three statuses: draft, planned, or coming-soon, each with a distinct icon and color.
frontend/src/components/Typography.tsx: Exports reusable typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, SubsectionTitle, BodyText) with consistent serif font and color styling.
frontend/src/components/wallet/QMYTransa: Displays a QMY transaction history card with loading, error, unsupported, empty, and populated states, rendering each transaction with an appropriate icon and details.
frontend/src/components/wallet/SendQMYSi: Provides a form card for simulating QMY token transfers, validating input and calling simulateSend, then showing success or error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/wallet/VestingBr: Shows a vesting breakdown card with available and locked QMY balances, a progress bar, and a live countdown timer to the next unlock event.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for pt/en language switching with localStorage persistence and a translation lookup function t().
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a typed backend canister actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useARGameData.ts: Fetches the authenticated user's AR game player profile from the Logic/Backend canister on the Internet Computer using a custom IDL factory and React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useCookieConsent.ts: Manages cookie consent state persisted in localStorage, exposing functions to give or revoke consent.
frontend/src/hooks/useDao.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, creating, and voting on DAO proposals using simulated in-memory storage backed by the canister actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useICPLedger.ts: Fetches the authenticated user's real ICP balance from the on-chain ICP ledger canister using an HttpAgent and React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useLuxuryBank.ts: Fetches token supply and account data from the canister actor and derives luxury bank dashboard metrics including time series, category breakdowns, and wallet statistics.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapMarkers.ts: Fetches all map markers from the backend canister actor using React Query with periodic refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublicChat.ts: Manages a local in-memory public chat message list with a simulated async send function.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYLedger.ts: Fetches the authenticated user's QMY token balance and metadata from the ICRC ledger canister using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYTransactions.ts: Fetches the authenticated user's QMY transaction history from the ICRC ledger canister, returning null if transactions are unsupported.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYVesting.ts: Stub hook for QMY vesting information that always returns null since vesting data is not currently exposed on-chain.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for reading and mutating the caller's player profile and state via the backend canister actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedQMYVestin: React hook that manages a simulated QMY token vesting schedule, persisting simulation state and start date in localStorage and computing available/locked token amounts via calculateVesting.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts and Leaflet styles, defines Tailwind base/components/utilities, and sets up a dark-themed design system with QMY yellow/gold as the primary brand color using CSS custom properties.
Utility functions for financial display: percentage change calculation, USD currency formatting, large number abbreviation (K/M/B), and SVG sparkline path generation from a value array.
frontend/src/lib/capacitor-plugins.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for Capacitor native plugin integrations.
frontend/src/lib/dao/preProposalsData.ts: Defines the PreProposal interface and exports a static array of sample DAO governance proposals covering treasury, distribution, tokenomics, and developer grant topics.
frontend/src/lib/deep-links.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for deep-link handling logic.
frontend/src/lib/icp/account.ts: Derives ICP account identifiers from a Principal using a simplified (non-cryptographically-secure) SHA-224 hash and CRC32 checksum, following the ICP ledger account identifier specification.
frontend/src/lib/icp/ledgerClient.ts: Provides an ICPLedgerClient class that queries ICP ledger canister balance via the Dfinity agent, plus a formatICPBalance helper to convert e8s to a human-readable ICP string.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/icrc.idl.ts: Defines the Candid IDL factory for an ICRC-1 token canister, exposing query methods for name, symbol, decimals, balance, and metadata.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/ledgerClient.ts: Provides an ICRCLedgerClient class for querying ICRC-1 token metadata and balances via the Dfinity agent, plus a formatBalance utility to convert raw token units to a human-readable string.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/transactions.ts: Attempts to query ICRC-1 transaction history for a given account using a dynamically constructed IDL, returning null if the canister does not support the icrc1_transactions method.
frontend/src/lib/map/mapDatasets.ts: Defines the MapMarker interface and exports static arrays of geographic markers for coins (COIN_MARKERS) and monsters (MONSTER_MARKERS) with real-world landmark coordinates, plus a DEFAULT_CENTER constant.
frontend/src/lib/map/simulatedMapProject: Exports a single function that converts latitude/longitude coordinates to 2D screen (x, y) positions using a simple equirectangular projection with zoom and center offset support.
frontend/src/lib/offline-manager.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
Defines the CentralBankData interface and exports a factory function returning simulated central bank statistics including token supply, categories, usage metrics, presale data, and geographic distribution.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/goldPaperSimData.ts: Defines interfaces and exports a factory function returning simulated Gold Paper distribution data, including hotspot locations at world landmarks and regional token allocation breakdowns.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/presaleSimData.ts: Defines presale phase interfaces and exports a factory function returning simulated presale data with three phases (Seed, Private, Public), their allocations, prices, bonuses, and statuses.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/simulatedSend.ts: Exports an async function that simulates a QMY token send operation with validation (principal format, amount, balance) and a 90% random success rate, returning a result object with an optional transaction hash.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/simulatedVesting.ts: Exports a function that calculates vesting state based on a start date, unlocking 100 tokens every 30 days from an initial locked balance of 900, and returns available, locked, and next unlock info.
